JAZAK-ALLAH ALLAH-HAFIZ Question: As salam u alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barqatuhu Hope you are well by the grace and the Blessings of Almighty Allah mere phophoo ko haj pe janne ki arji manzoor hogaye hai lekin unke saat koi mehram nahi hai to kya unki bhateeji jo aapne shahor ke saat ja rahe hai unke liye mehram banke ja sakti hai...... please send me reply as soon as possible.... JAZAK-ALLAH ALLAH-HAFIZ Answer ID: 13599 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1090/911=D/1430) A woman should be accompanied by a mahram in the whole journey of hajj, the husband of niece is not mahram to her; therefore it is unlawful to go to perform hajj with him though the niece is also with her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
